# Clerk React SPA patterns for Vite and CRA

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @clerk's official guide for `@clerk/react` in Vite/CRA single-page apps: ClerkProvider setup, the mental model of client-only auth, guarding on `isLoaded` before trusting `isSignedIn`, `useAuth`/`useUser`/`useClerk` hooks, protected routes with React Router, session JWT tokens for API calls, and custom sign-in/sign-up forms.
